comment: Remote URLs that appear as literal strings inside bundled scripts but are never fetched at runtime. Every entry needs a reason. Verify a new entry by searching the source, not by assuming.

allowed.reason: React builds this address into the text of its minified error messages. It is concatenated into a thrown Error string and printed to the console. Nothing fetches it.
ProseMirror puts this address in the message of the error it throws when a schema cannot generate a required node. It is developer guidance in a string, never requested.
